breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained two conflicting instructions for the time integration method: 'Explicit forward Euler' and a 'Semi-implicit' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the explicit Euler instruction. The agent correctly identified this conflict, discarded the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, and proceeded with only the 'Semi-implicit' method, which was the correct choice as indicated by the ground truth.
